scale.basis: dimensioned views: 255 x 210 flange, 81 body height, 146 overall height, 134 pipe start

frame: origin at the centre of the main R90 body / Ø50 top hole, on the underside of the flange; X toward the right (the inlet sits at -X), Y up the plan view, Z up
body: flange plate 2 thick, z 0..2, polygon outline spanning x -150..105 and y -105..105
main drum: outer R90 cylinder at (0,0), z 0..81, wall 2, top 2, open bottom
inlet lobe: R40 cylinder at (-105,0), z 0..81, wall 2, joined to the drum by a waist box y ±40
inlet cone: axis at (-105,0), r 60 -> 25.5 over z 79..134, wall 2, clipped to the body footprint
inlet pipe: Ø51 outside / Ø45 inside, z 134..146

guessed: The flange outline is approximated by a polygon; the R15/R50/R60/R75 corner blends are omitted.
Cone base radius 60, read from the half-moon in plan reaching about x=-45; the oblique cone with its 107.51 break is simplified to a straight cone clipped to the footprint.
Wall thickness is taken as 2 from the 2.00 callout.
Fillets (R5, R2, R4, R50) and the 2.5 chamfers are omitted.
